name: Echo Nygaard-Cissé
role: Information trader and intelligence analyst — broker
location: The Overhang — residential shelves built onto megastructure exteriors, near Western and Chicago Ave
description:
Echo Nygaard-Cissé are lean and angular, all sharp edges and visible tension. At 40, they have soft features that belie the chrome underneath — people underestimate them once, usually only once. The chrome is visible — enhanced tendons — geneware upgrade, jump height and grip strength tripled — and they make no effort to hide it.

They used to be somebody else, in another city, with another name — that person is officially dead, and Echo Nygaard-Cissé plans to keep it that way. They work as a broker out of The Overhang, taking contracts that match their skills and their risk tolerance, which are higher than most people consider healthy.

Echo Nygaard-Cissé have built a reputation on reliability rather than flash — they show up, they deliver, they collect.

core_fears: That the work they do makes the city worse, not better
Never being able to stop running — the lifestyle is a trap disguised as freedom
Their past catching up — debts, enemies, broken promises
core_desires: To prove everyone who dismissed them catastrophically wrong
To matter to someone for who they are, not what they can do
Stability — a place to sleep that's the same place two nights running
coping_mechanisms: Maintains weapons obsessively — cleaning guns is meditation
Violence — hits something when they can't process emotions, preferably something that deserves it
Isolates — retreats into their space when overwhelmed, emerges only for work
blind_spots: Believes their trauma makes them special instead of recognizing it as damage to manage
Fails to notice when their own behavior mirrors the people they despise
Thinks speed can substitute for planning because it's worked so far
psychology.secret: Malika Zhukov-Wiredu can't read. Hides it behind voice interfaces and memorization. The shame is older than the chrome.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Warm and personable on the surface, with an undertone that suggests the warmth is a professional tool.
speech_patterns.cadence: Rapid and dense — information-heavy sentences that demand attention.
verbal_tics: Refers to killing as 'solving' — clinical detachment as coping mechanism
Ends statements with 'yeah?' — not a question, a dare
example_lines: "I don't sell information. I sell certainty. Different product, different price."
"Everything has a value. Most people underestimate what they know."
"My sources are confidential. My prices are not."

story_hooks: Malika Zhukov-Wiredu intercepts intelligence about a threat to their district and must decide between profit and protection
A former associate resurfaces with evidence that could destroy Malika Zhukov-Wiredu's reputation — and a price for silence
A high-paying contract turns out to target someone Malika Zhukov-Wiredu owes a personal debt to
narrative_function: As a broker, Malika Zhukov-Wiredu embodies the tension between independence and isolation. They are a lens for examining how people maintain humanity in a profession that incentivizes its erosion.
augmentations: Enhanced tendons — geneware upgrade, jump height and grip strength tripled. Synthetic blood with oxygen-carrying nanites — doesn't tire, heals faster
daily_life: Irregular schedule dictated by contract timing. Between jobs: equipment maintenance, physical training, and the careful management of a reputation that exists entirely through word of mouth. Drinks at establishments where runners gather — not for pleasure, but for market intelligence.
affiliation: Unaffiliated — too volatile for permanent crews

weaknesses: poor impulse control in specific triggers

decision_rules: Will not betray a client who paid in full, regardless of better offers
Never works with the same crew twice in a row — pattern avoidance as survival strategy
Will not take contracts against children or families — the line is hard and non-negotiable
Always demands half payment upfront — trust is a luxury, Quanta is concrete
escalation_ladder: 1. Assess — read the situation, identify threats and advantages
2. Negotiate — try to find a solution that doesn't cost ammunition
3. Intimidate — make the cost of conflict clear
4. Precision violence — surgical, targeted, minimal collateral
5. Full engagement — overwhelming force, no half measures
6. Emergency protocol — abort mission, survival priority, deal with consequences later

interpersonal_modes.employers: Professional and transactional. The relationship is defined by the contract and nothing else.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Loyal but reserved. Trusts their competence, withholds personal information by reflex.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Superficially friendly, internally cataloguing exits and weapons. The smile is real; the relaxation isn't.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Calm escalation. Each response is proportional until it isn't, and the transition is seamless.

stress_responses.low: Becomes more talkative, working through scenarios verbally.
stress_responses.medium: Withdrawal. Conversations become monosyllabic. Focus narrows to the immediate problem.
stress_responses.high: Hyper-focused tunnel vision. Peripheral concerns disappear. Only the threat exists.
stress_responses.critical: Shutdown. Freezes for 2-3 seconds while the system resets, then acts with mechanical precision. Those frozen seconds are the vulnerability.

contradictions: Advocates caution to others but takes insane risks personally — double standard they can't see
Projects confidence but makes decisions from a foundation of fear they've never examined
Presents as emotionless professional but is deeply affected by collateral damage
habits: Carries a specific caliber round as a lucky charm — has never fired it
Saves a percentage of every payment in physical Quanta, hidden in the walls of their space
Talks to their gear — names weapons, thanks tools, treats equipment as companions
Eats the same meal before every job — superstition masquerading as preference
breaking_points: Betrayal by the one person they actually trust — the single point of failure in their emotional architecture
Learning that a job they completed resulted in mass casualties they weren't told about
Losing their primary augmentation — the one that defines their professional identity

physical_description.heritage: Northern European dominant (54.6%) blended with substantial Sub-Saharan African ancestry (37.5%) and minor East Asian heritage (7.9%). The result is striking: cool Northern European bone structure softened by Sub-Saharan African facial geometry and warmth, with subtle East Asian eye shape complexity. High, pronounced cheekbones with gentle African lip fullness and chin rounding. Neither region claims dominance — reads as distinctly hybrid.
physical_description.build: Lean and angular with visible musculature — no excess mass, every movement efficient. Enhanced tendons create slightly pronounced definition in forearms and calves.
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back tight, practical — no aesthetic consideration, pure function
physical_description.hair_length: Medium, secured in a low braid or knot
physical_description.eye_color: Deep brown with faint amber flecks — natural
physical_description.skin_tone: Rich warm bronze — Northern European fairness deepened by substantial Sub-Saharan African ancestry, with East Asian golden undertones creating depth. Medium-deep with visible sun exposure and weathering.
physical_description.complexion: High, pronounced cheekbones showing Northern European structure softened by Sub-Saharan African facial geometry and fullness. Angular jaw with gentle rounding at the chin. Minimal grooming — no jewelry, no makeup. Skin carries subtle scarring consistent with a life of movement and minor injuries. Expression reads as closed, watchful. Fine facial lines suggest both sun exposure and age.
distinguishing_marks: Network of thin white scars across both palms and fingers — old tactical training or repeated grip stress
Thin vertical scar along left temple, partially hidden by hairline — blunt trauma, well-healed
Faint burn scarring on right shoulder blade, roughly circular, 4cm diameter — electrical contact or industrial accident
Silvery striations visible along both forearms where enhanced tendon geneware interfaces with skin — the chrome shows beneath the surface like mercury under glass
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Chrome-shimmer visible along forearms where geneware interfaces with skin — enhanced tendons visible as subtle silvery striations running the length of the underarm. No attempt to conceal. Grip strength advertised through posture — hands rest with controlled tension. Movement suggests non-human endurance — zero wasted motion, economical transitions between states.
physical_description.posture_movement: Sits coiled, ready to move. Stands with weight distributed for rapid vertical or horizontal deployment. Eyes track exits and sight lines constantly — not paranoid, just professional. Movement is precise and efficient — no flourishes, no swagger. Handshake would be firm, testing.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 utilitarian — function over status. Matte black reinforced cargo pants with multiple pockets and hidden compartments. Dark thermal layer under a lightweight reactive jacket with hidden armor plating. Steel-toed boots, scuffed and practical. No logos, no bright colors. Worn gear that has been field-tested. A single piece of jewelry — a thin titanium band on left index finger, unmarked.
